aggregation_stories.title: What to know about a first-of-its kind flu shot for people over 50
aggregation_stories.summary: The FDA has approved Moderna's mFLUSIVA, the first mRNA flu shot, for adults aged 50 and older. Clinical trials showed it was more effective and produced a stronger immune response than traditional vaccines, especially for those 65 and older. While a good option for those 50-65, experts suggest those over 65 might still opt for high-dose traditional vaccines due to more extensive supporting science.

general_news.title: Revvity, Inc. entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Human Cell Design SAS.
general_news.summary: Revvity, Inc. has announced a definitive agreement to acquire Human Cell Design SAS. This acquisition will integrate HCD's human pancreatic beta cell models into Revvity's portfolio, enhancing its capabilities for drug discovery in metabolic disease therapies like GLP-1. The transaction is anticipated to conclude in the fourth quarter of 2026, pending standard closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
